plot: On a quiet afternoon in Grandma's living room Max's toys keep vanishing under the sofa, so he fears a toy-eating sofa monster; his banana trap vanishes too, Mouse peeks under and finds all the toys but no monster, and Max, remembering the swish sound each time, tests it himself and discovers the monster is Dog's happy wagging tail, which Grandma turns into the best broom in the house.

beats.say: My ball! It just went ZOOM under the sofa!
Gulp! Max's red ball is gone. Something under the sofa took it!
What lives under the sofa? And why is it eating my toys?
It is a quiet afternoon in Grandma's cozy living room.
Hi, Max! Hi, hi, hi! I'm so happy to see you!
Swish, swish goes Dog's happy tail. And Max's gold star... is gone!
Dog! The sofa just ate my gold star too! Did you see?
I only saw you, Max! You are my favorite thing to see!
Max peeks under the sofa. It is dark, dusty and very quiet.
This is serious, Dog. There's a toy-eating monster in our house.
A monster? Is it a friendly monster? Does it like treats?
Hello? Why is everybody shouting about monsters?
Mouse! You live near the sofa. Did you take my toys?
Me? My arms are tiny. I can't even lift a grape!
Hmm. That's true. A ball is way too big for you.
Something big must be under there. Something very, very hungry.
My blue toy key is the last toy I have left!
If the monster gets it, I'll have no toys at all!
Don't worry, Max! I'll guard your key. Good boy on duty!
I have a better plan. A monster trap!
Max puts a green box by the sofa. A banana on top!
Monsters love bananas. When it comes out... we catch it!
Ooh, a banana! Yum! I love bananas so much!
Swish, swish! And the box and the banana... are gone!
It ate the trap?! This monster is huge! Bigger than Grandma's chair!
Maybe the monster just really, really loves bananas. Like me!
We must find it before it eats your blue key too!
Okay. No more traps. I'll look under the sofa myself.
I'll come too! I'm brave! Mostly brave. A little brave.
I'm small. I can go in first and peek. Wait here!
Tiny Mouse tiptoes into the dark space under the sofa.
Max holds his breath. Dog holds his tail. Very still.
Max! I found your red ball! And your gold star!
And the green box, and the banana! But no monster!
No teeth marks? No monster footprints? Nothing at all?
Only dust bunnies. And Dog's old sock from last winter.
My sock! I looked for that sock for a hundred days!
A sock, a ball, a star... but no monster. That's strange.
Mouse rolls the toys back out, one by one. Roll, roll, roll.
So the toys aren't eaten. Something pushed them under there.
But who pushes toys and leaves no footprints? Think, Max, think.
If we don't find out, it will keep happening every day!
Wait. Every time a toy vanished, I heard the same sound.
Swish, swish. Like a broom. Where does a swish come from?
Brooms don't walk by themselves, Max. Something swished them.
Maybe from a wind? Or a very fast ghost broom?
Let's test it. Dog, stand by the sofa, next to my key.
Dog! Who wants a big crunchy treat? You do!
Me! Me! Treat! I love treats! Best day ever!
Swish, swish goes Dog's happy tail... and the blue key slides away!
The sofa monster is your tail, Dog! Your happy, swishy tail!
My tail? My own tail did it? Bad tail! No... happy tail!
Every time you're happy, your tail sweeps toys under the sofa!
But I'm happy all the time! Because Max is always here!
Aww, Dog. That's the nicest monster I ever met.
My, my! What is all this swishing in my living room?
Grandma, Dog's tail swept my toys away. It's a tail broom!
A tail broom? Then let's put it to work, dear Dog.
Grandma drops some cookie crumbs. Dog wags. Swish! The floor is clean!
Best broom in the house! And it comes with cuddles!
Dog swishes the whole rug clean. Swish here, swish there, swish everywhere!
I'm a broom! I'm a happy broom! Woof, woof!
Now we keep the toys far from the sofa, okay?
When something scary happens, look closely. It might be wagging!
Tomorrow, let's find out who hums at the window every night!
